components.notes: Baseline set. Activator: chrome for native <details> groups in .ma-accordion; data-exclusive keeps one open.

Launches a hosted app borderless. Three modes: fullscreen overlay + Fullscreen API (default), a separate window that arms itself via ?ma-fs=1, or inline. A page cannot fullscreen a window it opened, so the modes are a fallback ladder, not a switch.
Baseline set. CSS-only activator: .ma-callout info/success/warn/error admonition boxes; glyph icons, no images.
Baseline set. Content card (imageclass=/image=, title, text, href, footer); ships the .ma-cards responsive grid helper.
Baseline set. Activator: .ma-carousel of .ma-slide children — arrows, dots, keyboard, optional data-autoplay.

ChiMesh project page: three solar RAK4631 LoRa nodes running Meshtastic, deployed across Chicago rooftops. Shopping list, assembly, firmware flash, node config, deployment map, verify mesh, troubleshooting, summary stack. Best used with the Hardware theme.

Claudia project page: Pi Zero 2 WH + WonderEcho smart speaker running the Claude API. Shopping list, assembly steps, software setup, ASR/TTS config, healthcheck, run, case, troubleshooting, summary stack. Best used with the Hardware theme.
Baseline set. Activator: dresses every pre>code with chrome, copy button, data-lang badge. Highlighting = V2 candidate.
Baseline set. Name/email/message form POSTing to action= or the contact.action site setting; honeypot included; renders a config hint when unset.
The HTML counterpart of frommd: renders author HTML held in component metadata. Uses Plugin.header.

Renders Markdown (Markdig) held in the page's 'frommd' metadata slot, with an in-page edit mode that re-syncs from a source file. Ships Markdig in its bin/ -- the first citizen to carry a third-party dependency, which the packer and ALC load support. Uses Plugin.header.
Frontpage hub component (SiteNav/NavTabItem, hub.json seed data, cover images).
Baseline set. Activator: .ma-gallery grid of base64-class tiles; linked tiles = books grid, unlinked tiles get a lightbox.

CSS-only activator: ships all .hw-* structural layout classes (.hw-hero, .hw-title, .hw-tagline, .hw-badge-row, .hw-section, .hw-stack-table, .hw-warn, .hw-btn, .hw-steps) shared by the Claudia and ChiMesh components and any future hardware project page.
Canonical smallest component; click-counter is a live interactive-render smoke test. Fully inline, no assets.
Baseline set. Banner with title/subtitle/CTA; background via imageclass= (inline base64 CSS class convention) or image=.

Full product brochure for IdeaCms CMS: three-primitive model, token grammar, .idea package anatomy, DNN retrospective, feature comparison table, tech deep-dive, and get-started guide. CSS scoped under .ibr-*.
Self-contained landing page for the CMS itself: slide-in navigation drawer plus marketing sections. Distinct from ideasbrochure, which is the longer-form product tour.
Persona gallery component (PersonaCard/PersonaDetail, personas.json). Detail panel uses the ModalPopup component.
Renders a managed MindAttic.Media asset as an , addressed by the stable Uid shown in Admin -> Media. The DB-backed alternative to base64-inlining an image into page markup.
Renders a managed MindAttic.Media asset as a hyperlink; images and PDFs open inline, everything else downloads.
Self-contained mindattic.com frontpage component. All CSS scoped under .maf-* (assets/maf.css); copyright-year JS runs as a scoped IIFE.

Full-featured Blazor modal component. Parameters: IsOpen (bool, default true), Title, ShowClose (bool?, default true), ShowHeader, ShowFooter, ConfirmText, CancelText, WrapForm (wraps dialog in <form> for submit), Size (sm/md/lg/xl/full, default md), Config (JSON string — fallback defaults; typed params win), ChildContent, OnClose, OnConfirm, OnCancel. CSS always emitted so .ma-modal* classes work for plain-HTML callers. Standalone modalpopup.js retained for non-Blazor Escape/backdrop delegation.

The masthead a project page opens with: status, tagline, tech badges, links and a lead image, then ChildContent for whatever that project needs. A SHELL, not a page -- 34 projects share only an identity. widehero breaks a 5:1 flowchart out of the reading column.

Card grid over child pages, enriched from the 'repo' metadata slot (description, language, stargazers, topics, homepage). From="<slug>" lists ANOTHER page's children (via IPageTree.ChildrenOfSlugAsync) so a home page can show the projects index; Topic, NamePrefix and ExcludeNamePrefix filter, which is how one topic splits into the Software and MindAttic Ecosystem grids. Resolves its host features through the render context and degrades to a link list, then to nothing, as they go missing. Topic filter bar; most-starred-first ordering.

mindattic.com verbatim set. The project-board engine: .tabButton/.tabPage styles + board script (panel lift, procedural tile art, localStorage persistence, single-active click handling); window.TabBoard.build/art/images for data-built boards. Placement option alwaysShowTabPage=true keeps a selected item always visible (no fully-collapsed boards; first tab opens when nothing is saved).
Razor component; renders a table of contents. Inline markup, no bundled assets.
Baseline set. Activator: .ma-tabs sections with data-title become an ARIA tab control; ma-tabs-board = the mindattic.com tile board.
Angular-Material-style outlined text field; typed [Parameter] props plus pass-through attributes.
Baseline set. Responsive player: YouTube/Vimeo URLs become privacy-friendly embeds; other URLs (incl. data:) render native <video>.
mindattic.com verbatim set. The UiUx WEBSNAPSHOT bundle: .web-snapshot framed screenshot viewer (fetch or inline-base64 mode); window.WebSnapshot.autoInit() for late-built containers.
Attic display typeface; base64-embedded @font-face, exposes --font-attic.
Back-home glyph/link plugin.
Baseline set. Activator: zero author markup — a floating scroll-to-top button appears after one screen of scroll.
Baseline set. Trail derived lexically from slug segments; renders nothing on the home page.
Animated console-bg effects engine (js + circuitboard image assets); paints into layers rendered by the Cyberspace theme.
Baseline set. Activator: chrome + the mindattic.com pin-when-short behavior for any author-written footer.ma-footer.
Three-column fixed header (logo | center | user dropdown). Auth is entirely server-side: AuthorizeView gates the dropdown and logout posts a real form. Renders BeforeBody (the default slot).
Baseline set. Site nav bar; links= attribute or nav.links site setting (per-site menus); hamburger below 720px.
Display typeface plugin; emits one stylesheet, registers a font family + token.
mindattic.com verbatim set. The UiUx PINFOOTER bundle: .pin-when-short pins while the document is shorter than the viewport. Authentic implementation; distinct from the generic plugin.footer.

Site footer and the CMS byline. Declares Slot=AfterBody so it renders after the theme/body. Emits a real <footer class="ma-footer pin-when-short">, so Plugin.Footer styles it and Plugin.PinFooter pins it while the page is shorter than the viewport — both by class contract, neither required. Text/links come from the footer.text and footer.links settings; the 'Powered by' badge always renders and points at the Ideas brochure page.
Sacred-geometry animation (js); composed by LegionPersonas.
Baseline set. Icon row for GitHub/X/LinkedIn/YouTube/email/website/RSS; inline SVG path data (no icon files); social.* site-setting fallbacks.

Site-wide light/dark switch. Sets html[data-theme-mode] and persists the choice in localStorage (mindattic.theme-mode); App.razor sets the server-rendered first-visit default from the site's DefaultThemeMode.
Tooltip behavior + styling (css + js); composed by Frontpage.
Composes its look from four separately-installed Plugin .ideas by string id; bundles only its own chrome (theme.css).

Industrial/maker dark chrome: PCB-green palette, monospace typography, scan-line texture. Structural .hw-* layout classes live in the HardwareHero component; compose that alongside any page that uses this theme. Both light and dark palettes verified WCAG 2.2 AA, switched via html[data-theme-mode].

The CMS's own default theme. Merges the former standalone Light and Dark themes into one theme with two WCAG 2.2 AA palettes, switched via html[data-theme-mode] (the ThemeToggle plugin). Self-contained chrome scoped under .theme-ideas.
